summary: The Intelligent China webpage launches this week, anchoring the team's SEO/AI-search push alongside Asia Star, while the Knowledge website redesign nears final feedback and a lingering Outlook lockout needs a quick team-wide fix.
summaryDetail: The top priority right now is the launch of the Intelligent China webpage this week, which—together with Asia Star—forms the core of the global marketing strategy to boost SEO and AI-search visibility; US partner programs like Berkeley remain secondary. In parallel, the Knowledge website redesign is in final review: the team has settled on the two-menu structure, card-based content types, and a BCI banner in the Knowledge section, and Joseph must share the HTML concept before a 30-minute feedback session leads to Joker's design changes. This week also requires clearing the Outlook account lockout by re-logging in and updating stale credentials across all devices, and kicking off promotion for the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum now that speakers are confirmed. Upcoming milestones include Joseph's target-audience and prompt document for SEO, an audit of Google Ads conversion tracking, and finalizing the Western MBA teacher training press release; the website redesign PPT and email to Zongchao should wait until the new English homepage and both URLs are live.

decisions.text: Re-login and update passwords across all devices to prevent repeated lockouts.
Remove the dedicated videos section; videos will be dispersed by topic across the site.
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge menu and School menu) at the top.
Bring the BCI banner into the Knowledge section, similar to the school homepage.
Do not display a stock-market ticker at the very top of the homepage.
Use card designs to visually distinguish content types (professor analysis, articles, etc.) for better UX.
Asia Star and Intelligent China are the top two program priorities; US partner programs (Stanford, Columbia, Berkeley) are secondary.
Berkeley is the preferred third priority among US programs if a third is added.
Intelligent China webpage launches this week, enabling SEO optimization alongside Asia Star.
Wait until the new English homepage is launched before sending the website redesign PPT and email to Zongchao, and include both website URLs.
